articles.title: Nifty 50 hits 9-month high, crosses 25,500: Can the rally extend towards 25,800? Here's what analysts say
articles.description: The Nifty 50 rose 0.38% to a nine-month high on Tuesday, briefly crossing 25,500, as banking and realty shares gained and easing oil prices and foreign inflows lifted sentiment. Analysts see further upside if the index clears 25,500, with 25,000–25,200 as key support.

articles.title: Indian bonds surge after oil slide eases aggressive rate hike concerns
articles.description: On Tuesday, Indian government bonds rallied significantly, buoyed by falling oil prices that shifted market sentiment. The 6.94% 2036 bond's yield dipped to 7.2528%, a drop from 7.3169% the previous day. Analysts posit that lower oil prices could relieve inflationary pressure and bolster the rupee, alongside speculation of an upcoming RBI rate hike based on fresh inflation reports.
